⚡ Site changelog


Here you'll find a summary of the latest updates, new tools, and added guides for the sorola.fi web service and its subpages.

5.8.2026 – Guides and privacy policies for all tools
  • Added usage guides for QR code creator, password generator, pastebin, JSON formatter and Base64 encoder.
  • Added privacy policies for all services: QR, Pastebin, File sharing, JSON formatter and Base64.
  • Removed Sorolan Holvi browser extension (replaced by Vaultwarden).
4.8.2026 – New guides and privacy policies
  • Added new comprehensive usage guides for services and IT tools.
  • Updated and added proper privacy policies for web tools and services.
3.8.2026 – JSON Formatter
  • Added a new JSON Formatter & Validator to the advanced tools section.
  • The tool works entirely locally in the browser without sending any data to the server.
1.8.2026 – Tool grouping & webtools.sorola.fi
  • Tools grouped more clearly into basic tools and developer-oriented advanced tools.
  • Launched a new subdomain webtools.sorola.fi for the web tools collection.
31.7.2026 – Android app release
  • Sorola's own Android app (.apk download) created and released, making it easier to use the basic tools on mobile devices.
